D.t: Ro Khanna leads by 59.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 156,813 votes; a one point swing is about 1,330 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +54.1 and D +63.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$16.9M cash against $702. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
